description: Scan for security problems and get deterministic remediation guidance so YOU (the AI agent) can fix them. Works with no account: without SPHIOR_API_KEY it scans the local workspace with the bundled engine. SPHIOR does not generate code or transmit source — open the referenced file in your workspace, read the code yourself, and apply the fix. Returns why-it-matters, remediation steps, exact location, and references. Findings at the same line are merged into one entry; `also` lists the others and one fix must satisfy all. A human must review before merge.

findingId.description: A specific finding fingerprint to fix. Omit for all findings.

path.description: Local mode only: directory to scan. Omit to scan the directory this server was launched in. Use it to narrow a large repository.

repo.description: Cloud mode only: repository full_name (owner/repo). Omit for the latest scanned repo.

name: get_fix_context
